contexts.text: Priests and presbyters who preach devoutly, yet live evilly...
The presbyters who are in the west (of London)... LJPost 299.
I have heard the presbyters from England conversing about faith alone... TCR 810:end. AE 587:3.
I heard a certain presbyter... saying that no one could have an idea of the Divine Human... DLW 11:2. TCR 836:end.
I was permitted to interrogate some presbyters of England who preached faith alone...
The presbyters who were in that faith embraced and kissed the locusts...
There are many of the presbyters among them, whom I have asked what they thought when they read in the Word about works...
We therefore unanimously agree with our priests and elders...
This was tried with... a presbyter of the Moravian congregation...
The Africans brought the Word to their elders, who said that they have the Word... LJPost 227.
